title: epan: constify the packet_info pointer in find_conversation functions
description:
For the conversation functions that find an existing conversation
using information from the packet_info, constify the packet_info
pointer.

In particular, since the various fragment_ functions in reassemble.h
and the fragment key function pointer typedef take a const packet_info *,
this allows implementing fragment key functions that lookup the
conversation on a packet.
